incidents.name: XST fee-on-transfer skim loop
incidents.notes: XST charged its transfer fee in a way that credited the Uniswap pair on every pair.skim(), so repeatedly skimming the pair to itself inflated the attacker's XST balance, which was then dumped for the pool's WETH.

sources.ref: onchain review: XST proxy 0x91383A15C391c142b80045D8b4730C1c37ac0378 created 2021-01-24T05:02:06Z by 0xcee3101c0a8167f083f34b95a2f243c9b0bef6a6, unrelated to the attack sender; one EIP-1967 Upgraded event on 2021-02-06T03:16:49Z installing logic 0xb276647e70cb3b81a1ca302cf8de280ff0ce5799 (the logic named in the PoC), so age runs from that upgrade (549.7 days). Loss read from the tx receipt: 27.13 WETH unwrapped by the attack contract; x $1,691.01 at incidentTimestamp 1660075466 (DefiLlama) = $45,877.
